set.body: Generalize route compilation beyond one non-identity volume-to-surface edge. Walk final volume or surface samples backward through supported affine, nonlinear, volume-to-surface, and surface-to-surface morphisms to one root-support operator. Acceptance: mixed routes validate domain transitions and mesh or geometry compatibility; the volume-to-surface compiler no longer rejects otherwise valid surrounding transforms; target selection is pushed into compilation; one final root sampling operator is emitted where mathematically valid; cross-platform fixtures cover affine-to-ribbon and nonlinear-to-surface chains.
set.title: Spatial mixed-domain pullbacks: arbitrary volume, warp, and surface routes
